body.title: Implement collectDependencyAdvisories
body.summary: collectDependencyAdvisories(repoPath, targets) orchestrates the full sc2 collection: computes contentIdentity once before any manager runs (propagating a failure here) and once after the last manager's audit completes (catching a failure here as contentStable:false, never propagating); for each manager enumerateManagers finds, calls verifyManagerClosureCoverage before (gating whether it is audited at all, 'unsupported' if not covered) and after (a post-audit regression also sets contentStable:false) its audit; invokes pkgAuditTool per manager with the t5-generated requirementsPath + noDeps:true for pipenv/poetry, or the project's own requirements.txt with no noDeps for plain pip; maps each manager's raw output into SecurityAdvisoryMatch[]; records every manager's configuredDestination and perManagerMode, and accounts every queried coordinate into exactly one of matches/unresolvedDependencies/queriedCoordinates-only.
acceptanceChecks: a manager's closure is covered:true pre-audit but covered:false post-audit (a new file appeared during the audit) -> contentStable:false, that manager's own results are still returned
a targets.entries file deleted between the pre- and post-collection computeContentIdentity calls -> contentStable:false, no exception escapes collectDependencyAdvisories
the FIRST computeContentIdentity call's own repoPath-level precondition failure DOES propagate (distinct from the second-call case)
a generated requirementsPath (pipenv/poetry) is ALWAYS invoked with noDeps:true; plain pip's own requirements.txt is NEVER invoked with noDeps:true
pkg_audit spawnError for a manager -> recorded in unavailableSources, never thrown
every attempted manager's perManagerMode entry carries a configuredDestination

a cleanly-checked coordinate with no advisory match appears in queriedCoordinates only; a coordinate with a confirmed finding appears in matches; an unresolved/unavailable coordinate appears in unresolvedDependencies/unavailableSources -- never more than one of these three

tests.name: collectDependencyAdvisories: a generated requirementsPath (pipenv/poetry) is ALWAYS invoked with noDeps:true
collectDependencyAdvisories: plain pip's own requirements.txt is NEVER invoked with noDeps:true

collectDependencyAdvisories: a targets.entries file is deleted between the pre- and post-collection computeContentIdentity calls -> contentStable:false, no exception escapes collectDependencyAdvisories
collectDependencyAdvisories: the FIRST computeContentIdentity call fails its own repoPath-level precondition -> the error DOES propagate (distinct from the second-call case)
a cleanly-audited coordinate with no advisory match -> appears in queriedCoordinates only
collectDependencyAdvisories: pkg_audit spawnError for a manager -> recorded in unavailableSources
collectDependencyAdvisories: every attempted manager's perManagerMode entry carries a configuredDestination

collectDependencyAdvisories against a real poetry project with an excluded private dependency that is also a transitive dependency of an exported package: the excluded package is NOT resolved or reported on
